name: SimpleGraph.card_vertexFinset_eq_card_add_card_compl

lemma card_vertexFinset_eq_card_add_card_compl (S : Set V) :

name: SimpleGraph.card_vertexFinset_induce_compl_lt

name: SimpleGraph.card_vertexFinset_eq_zero_of_isEmpty
statement: lemma card_vertexFinset_eq_zero_of_isEmpty (hV : IsEmpty V) : #V(G) = 0

name: SimpleGraph.card_toFinset_closedNeighborSet
statement:
lemma card_toFinset_closedNeighborSet (v : V) :
    #(G.closedNeighborSet v).toFinset = G.degree v + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : (G.closedNeighborSet v).toFinset = insert v (G.neighborFinset v) := by
    ext w
    rw [Set.mem_toFinset]
    simp [closedNeighborSet]
  rw [h, card_insert_of_notMem (G.notMem_neighborFinset_self v),
    card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]

name: SimpleGraph.expect_card_closedNeighborSet

lemma expect_card_closedNeighborSet (hV : Nonempty V) :
    𝔼 v, (#(G.closedNeighborSet v).toFinset : ℝ) = d(G) + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [card_toFinset_closedNeighborSet, Nat.cast_add_one, expect_add_distrib,

name: SimpleGraph.map_edgeFinset_induce_eq_edgeFinsetOn

name: SimpleGraph.card_edgeFinset_induce
statement: lemma card_edgeFinset_induce (S : Set V) : #E(G.induce S) = #(G.edgeFinsetOn S)

name: SimpleGraph.card_edgeIncidenceFinset_eq_zero_of_averageDegree_eq_zero

name: SimpleGraph.averageDegree_induce_eq_zero_of_averageDegree_eq_zero
statement:
lemma averageDegree_induce_eq_zero_of_averageDegree_eq_zero (hd : d(G) = 0) (S : Set V) :

name: SimpleGraph.card_edgeFinset_eq_card_edgeIncidenceFinset_add_card_induce_compl

lemma card_edgeFinset_eq_card_edgeIncidenceFinset_add_card_induce_compl (S : Set V) :

  convert (card_filter_add_card_filter_not (∃ v ∈ S, v ∈ ·) (s := E(G))).symm using 2

name: SimpleGraph.edgeIncidenceFinset_singleton

name: SimpleGraph.mem_edgeIncidenceFinset_closedNeighborSet_iff

lemma mem_edgeIncidenceFinset_closedNeighborSet_iff (e : Sym2 V) (v : V) :

    ∃ w ∈ G.neighborSet v, e ∈ G.incidenceSet w

:= by
  induction e with

    simp only [edgeIncidenceFinset, mem_filter, mem_edgeFinset, mem_edgeSet, closedNeighborSet,

name: SimpleGraph.pairwiseDisjoint_incidenceSet_neighborSet_of_triangleFree
statement:
lemma pairwiseDisjoint_incidenceSet_neighborSet_of_triangleFree (v : V) (hT : G.CliqueFree 3) :
    (G.neighborSet v).PairwiseDisjoint G.incidenceSet
proof:
:= fun _ hu _ hw huw ↦
  Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr <| G.incidenceSet_inter_incidenceSet_of_not_adj
    (isIndepSet_neighborSet_of_triangleFree G hT v hu hw huw) huw

name: SimpleGraph.pairwiseDisjoint_incidenceFinset_neighborSet_of_triangleFree
statement:
lemma pairwiseDisjoint_incidenceFinset_neighborSet_of_triangleFree (v : V) (hT : G.CliqueFree 3) :
    (G.neighborSet v).PairwiseDisjoint (fun u ↦ G.incidenceFinset u)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← Finset.pairwiseDisjoint_coe, coe_incidenceFinset] using
    pairwiseDisjoint_incidenceSet_neighborSet_of_triangleFree v hT

name: SimpleGraph.card_edgeIncidenceFinset_closedNeighborSet
statement:
lemma card_edgeIncidenceFinset_closedNeighborSet (hT : G.CliqueFree 3) (v : V) :
    #(G.edgeIncidenceFinset (G.closedNeighborSet v)) = ∑ u ∈ G.neighborFinset v, G.degree u
proof:
:= by
  simp [edgeIncidenceFinset_closedNeighborSet, card_biUnion ((coe_neighborFinset G v).symm ▸
    pairwiseDisjoint_incidenceFinset_neighborSet_of_triangleFree v hT)]

name: SimpleGraph.expect_card_edgeIncidenceFinset_closedNeighborSet
statement:
lemma expect_card_edgeIncidenceFinset_closedNeighborSet (hT : G.CliqueFree 3) :
    𝔼 v, (#(G.edgeIncidenceFinset (G.closedNeighborSet v)) : ℚ) = 𝔼 v, (G.degree v : ℚ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [expect_eq_sum_div_card, card_edgeIncidenceFinset_closedNeighborSet hT, Nat.cast_sum]
  congr 1
  rw [sum_comm' (s' := fun u ↦ G.neighborFinset u) (t' := univ) fun v u ↦ by simp [adj_comm]]
  simp [pow_two]

name: SimpleGraph.expect_card_edgeIncidenceFinset_closedNeighborSet_real
statement:
lemma expect_card_edgeIncidenceFinset_closedNeighborSet_real (hT : G.CliqueFree 3) :
    𝔼 v, (#(G.edgeIncidenceFinset (G.closedNeighborSet v)) : ℝ) = 𝔼 v, (G.degree v : ℚ)^2
proof:
:=
  expect_card_edgeIncidenceFinset_closedNeighborSet hT ▸ (map_expect (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) _ _).symm

name: SimpleGraph.sq_averageDegree_le_expect_sq_degree

name: SimpleGraph.bot_mem_indepSetFinsetAll

name: SimpleGraph.indepSetFinsetAll_nonempty

proof: := ⟨⊥, bot_mem_indepSetFinsetAll⟩

name: SimpleGraph.mem_indepSetFinsetAll_of_subset
statement:
lemma mem_indepSetFinsetAll_of_subset {S₁ S₂ : Set V} (hind : S₁ ∈ ℐ(G)) (hsub : S₂ ⊆ S₁) :
    S₂ ∈ ℐ(G)
proof:
:=
  mem_indepSetFinsetAll_iff.mpr ((mem_indepSetFinsetAll_iff.mp hind).mono hsub)

name: SimpleGraph.mem_indepSetFinsetAll_induce_iff
statement:
lemma mem_indepSetFinsetAll_induce_iff (S : Set V) (I : Set S) :
    I ∈ ℐ(G.induce S) ↔ Subtype.val '' I ∈ ℐ(G)
proof: := by simp [mem_indepSetFinsetAll_iff, Set.Pairwise]

name: SimpleGraph.embeddingOfSubsetSubtype_apply
statement:
lemma embeddingOfSubsetSubtype_apply (S : Set V) (I : Set S) : embeddingOfSubsetSubtype S I =

name: SimpleGraph.map_indepSetFinsetAll_induce_eq_filter_subset
statement:
lemma map_indepSetFinsetAll_induce_eq_filter_subset (S : Set V) :
    map (embeddingOfSubsetSubtype S) ℐ(G.induce S) = filter (· ⊆ S) ℐ(G)
proof:
:= by
  ext I

name: SimpleGraph.mem_indepSetFinsetAll_and_subset_of_mem_induce

name: SimpleGraph.card_indepSetFinsetAll_induce
statement:
lemma card_indepSetFinsetAll_induce (S : Set V) [DecidablePred (· ∈ S)] :
    #ℐ(G.induce S) = #(filter (· ⊆ S) ℐ(G))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_indepSetFinsetAll_induce_eq_filter_subset, Finset.card_map]

name: SimpleGraph.ncard_le_indepNum_of_mem_indepSetFinsetAll
statement: lemma ncard_le_indepNum_of_mem_indepSetFinsetAll {I : Set V} (hI : I ∈ ℐ(G)) : I.ncard ≤ α(G)
proof:
:=
  I.ncard_eq_toFinset_card' ▸
    (I.coe_toFinset.symm ▸ mem_indepSetFinsetAll_iff.mp hI).card_le_indepNum

name: SimpleGraph.exists_mem_indepSetFinsetAll_ncard_eq_indepNum
statement: lemma exists_mem_indepSetFinsetAll_ncard_eq_indepNum : ∃ I ∈ ℐ(G), I.ncard = α(G)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨s, hs⟩ := G.exists_isNIndepSet_indepNum
  ⟨s, mem_indepSetFinsetAll_iff.mpr hs.isIndepSet, (Set.ncard_coe_finset s).trans hs.card_eq⟩

name: SimpleGraph.insert_mem_indepSetFinsetAll_iff
statement:
lemma insert_mem_indepSetFinsetAll_iff {S : Set V} :
    insert v S ∈ ℐ(G) ↔ S ∈ ℐ(G) ∧ ∀ u ∈ S, ¬G.Adj v u
proof:
:= by
  grind [mem_indepSetFinsetAll_iff, Set.pairwise_insert, adj_comm, SimpleGraph.irrefl]

name: SimpleGraph.subset_compl_closedNeighborSet_iff_insert_mem_indepSetFinsetAll
proof:
:= by
  rw [insert_mem_indepSetFinsetAll_iff]
  simp only [hI, true_and, Set.subset_def, closedNeighborSet, Set.mem_compl_iff,
    Set.mem_insert_iff, mem_neighborSet, not_or]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun hv ↦ (h v hv).1 rfl, fun u hu ↦ (h u hu).2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hv, hI'⟩ u hu
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ hv (h ▸ hu), hI' u hu⟩

name: SimpleGraph.indepNum_induce_compl_closedNeighborSet_add_one_le
statement:
lemma indepNum_induce_compl_closedNeighborSet_add_one_le [Finite V] (v : V) :
    α(G) ≥ α(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype V
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hI_card⟩ :=
    (G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ).exists_mem_indepSetFinsetAll_ncard_eq_indepNum
  rw [← hI_card, ge_iff_le]
  have := mem_indepSetFinsetAll_and_subset_of_mem_induce (by convert hI)
  rw [subset_compl_closedNeighborSet_iff_insert_mem_indepSetFinsetAll this.1] at this
  convert ncard_le_indepNum_of_mem_indepSetFinsetAll this.2.2
  rw [Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem this.2.1, Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective]

name: SimpleGraph.card_filter_subset_compl_closedNeighborSet_aux
statement:
private lemma card_filter_subset_compl_closedNeighborSet_aux (v : V) :
    #(filter (· ⊆ (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ) ℐ(G)) = #(filter (v ∈ ·) ℐ(G))
proof:
:= by
  refine card_bij' (fun S _ ↦ insert v S) (fun S _ ↦ S \ {v}) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro S hS
    rw [mem_filter] at hS ⊢
    exact ⟨((subset_compl_closedNeighborSet_iff_insert_mem_indepSetFinsetAll hS.1).1 hS.2).2,
      Set.mem_insert v S⟩
  · intro S hS
    rw [mem_filter] at hS ⊢
    have hI : S \ {v} ∈ ℐ(G) := mem_indepSetFinsetAll_of_subset hS.1 Set.sdiff_subset
    exact ⟨hI, (subset_compl_closedNeighborSet_iff_insert_mem_indepSetFinsetAll hI).mpr
      ⟨fun h ↦ h.2 rfl,
        mem_indepSetFinsetAll_of_subset hS.1 (Set.insert_subset hS.2 Set.sdiff_subset)⟩⟩
  · exact fun S hS ↦ Set.insert_sdiff_self_of_notMem
      fun hv ↦ (mem_filter.mp hS).2 hv self_mem_closedNeighborSet
  · exact fun S hS ↦ Set.insert_sdiff_self_of_mem (mem_filter.mp hS).2

name: SimpleGraph.card_indepSetFinsetAll_recursion
statement:
lemma card_indepSetFinsetAll_recursion (v : V) :
    #ℐ(G) = #ℐ(G.induce {v}ᶜ) + #ℐ(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [card_indepSetFinsetAll_induce, card_filter_subset_compl_closedNeighborSet_aux,
    Set.subset_compl_singleton_iff]
  exact (card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := ℐ(G)) (v ∈ ·)).symm.trans (add_comm _ _)

name: ConvexOn.map_expect_le
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < #t := Nat.cast_pos.2 (card_pos.2 ht)
  simp_rw [expect_eq_sum_div_card, sum_div, div_eq_inv_mul, ← smul_eq_mul]
  exact hf.map_sum_le (fun _ _ ↦ inv_nonneg.2 hc.le)
    (by simp [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne']) hmem

name: Real.exp_expect_le_expect_exp
statement:
lemma _root_.Real.exp_expect_le_expect_exp {ι : Type*} {t : Finset ι} (ht : t.Nonempty)
    (g : ι → ℝ) : Real.exp (𝔼 i ∈ t, g i) ≤ 𝔼 i ∈ t, Real.exp (g i)
proof:
:=
  ConvexOn.map_expect_le ht _ (fun _ _ ↦ Set.mem_univ _) convexOn_exp

name: SimpleGraph.shearerError_of_nonempty
statement:
lemma shearerError_of_nonempty {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hV : Nonempty V) :
    shearerError G f f' a b = a * (d(G) * f' d(G) - f d(G)) + b * (-2 * f' d(G))
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left hV

name: SimpleGraph.shearerError_of_isEmpty
statement:
lemma shearerError_of_isEmpty {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hV : IsEmpty V) :
    shearerError G f f' a b = 0
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_right (not_nonempty_iff.2 hV)

name: SimpleGraph.shearerError_add_one_sq
statement:
lemma shearerError_add_one_sq {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hV : Nonempty V) :
    G.shearerError f f' (d(G) + 1) (d(G) ^ 2) =
    (d(G) - d(G) ^ 2) * f' d(G) - (d(G) + 1) * f d(G)
proof:
:=
  (shearerError_of_nonempty hV).trans (by ring)

name: SimpleGraph.shearerError_one
statement:
lemma shearerError_one {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hV : Nonempty V) : G.shearerError f f' 1 d(G) =
    -d(G) * f' d(G) - f d(G)
proof: := (shearerError_of_nonempty hV).trans (by ring)

name: SimpleGraph.expect_shearerError
statement:
lemma expect_shearerError {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {g₁ g₂ : V → ℝ} :
    𝔼 v, shearerError G f f' (g₁ v) (g₂ v) = shearerError G f f' (𝔼 v, g₁ v) (𝔼 v, g₂ v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain hV | hV := isEmpty_or_nonempty V
  · simp [shearerError_of_isEmpty hV]
  · simp [shearerError_of_nonempty hV, expect_add_distrib, ← expect_mul]

name: SimpleGraph.shearerError_card_zero_of_averageDegree_eq_zero
statement:
lemma shearerError_card_zero_of_averageDegree_eq_zero {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} (S : Set V) (h : d(G) = 0) :
    shearerError G f f' (#S.toFinset) 0 = -(#S.toFinset) * f 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain hV | hV := isEmpty_or_nonempty V
  · simp [shearerError_of_isEmpty hV]
  · simp [shearerError_of_nonempty hV, h]

name: SimpleGraph.shearerError_le_shearerError_of_le
statement:
lemma shearerError_le_shearerError_of_le {a b c : ℝ} {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hf' : ∀ x, 0 < x → f' x ≤ 0)
    (hab : b ≤ c) (hdG : 0 < d(G)) :
    shearerError G f f' a b ≤ shearerError G f f' a c
proof:
:= by
  obtain hV | hV := isEmpty_or_nonempty V
  · simp [shearerError_of_isEmpty hV]
  · simp only [shearerError_of_nonempty hV]
    gcongr
    linarith [hf' d(G) (Rat.cast_pos.mpr hdG)]

name: SimpleGraph.shearer_convex_step
statement:
lemma shearer_convex_step {V₁ V₂ : Type} [Fintype V₁] [Fintype V₂]
    {H₁ : SimpleGraph V₁} {H₂ : SimpleGraph V₂} (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ConvexIneq f f')
    (hdH₁ : 0 < d(H₁)) : #V(H₂) * f d(H₂) ≥
    #V(H₁) * f d(H₁) + shearerError H₁ f f' (#V(H₁) - #V(H₂)) (#E(H₁) - #E(H₂))
proof:
:= by
  have h_ineq := hf d(H₂) d(H₁) (Rat.cast_nonneg.2 averageDegree_nonneg) (Rat.cast_pos.2 hdH₁)
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ineq (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  rw [shearerError_of_nonempty (nonempty_of_averageDegree_pos hdH₁)]
  have e₁ : (#V(H₁) : ℝ) * d(H₁) = 2 * #E(H₁) := by
    exact_mod_cast card_mul_averageDegree_eq_twice_card_edges
  have e₂ : (#V(H₂) : ℝ) * d(H₂) = 2 * #E(H₂) := by
    exact_mod_cast card_mul_averageDegree_eq_twice_card_edges
  linear_combination f' d(H₁) * e₁ - f' d(H₁) * e₂

name: SimpleGraph.convex_step_induce
statement:
lemma convex_step_induce (S : Set V) {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConvexIneq f f')
  : #V(G.induce Sᶜ) * f d(G.induce Sᶜ) ≥ #V(G) * f d(G) +
    shearerError G f f' #S.toFinset #(G.edgeIncidenceFinset S)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : d(G) = 0
  · have hd' : d(induce Sᶜ G) = 0 := by
      convert averageDegree_induce_eq_zero_of_averageDegree_eq_zero hd Sᶜ
    rw [hd, hd', Rat.cast_zero,
      card_edgeIncidenceFinset_eq_zero_of_averageDegree_eq_zero hd, Nat.cast_zero,
      shearerError_card_zero_of_averageDegree_eq_zero _ hd, neg_mul, ge_iff_le,
      add_neg_le_iff_le_add, ← add_mul, ← Nat.cast_add, add_comm, card_vertexFinset_induce,
      card_vertexFinset_eq_card_add_card_compl S]
  · convert shearer_convex_step (H₁ := G) (H₂ := G.induce Sᶜ) f f' hf
      (averageDegree_pos_of_ne_zero hd) <;>
    rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_inj]
    · rw [card_vertexFinset_induce]
      exact (card_vertexFinset_eq_card_add_card_compl S).symm
    · exact (card_edgeFinset_eq_card_edgeIncidenceFinset_add_card_induce_compl S).symm

name: SimpleGraph.convex_step_expect
statement:
lemma convex_step_expect {F : V → Set V} {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConvexIneq f f')
  : 𝔼 v, #V(G.induce (F v)ᶜ) * f d(G.induce (F v)ᶜ) ≥ #V(G) * f d(G) +
    shearerError G f f' (𝔼 v, #(F v).toFinset) (𝔼 v, #(G.edgeIncidenceFinset (F v)))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (expect_le_expect fun v _ ↦ convex_step_induce _ hf)
  rw [expect_add_distrib, expect_shearerError]
  congr 1
  by_cases hV : #V(G) = 0
  · simp [hV]
  · exact (expect_const (card_ne_zero.mp hV) _).symm

name: SimpleGraph.convex_step_expect_closedNeighbor
statement:
lemma convex_step_expect_closedNeighbor {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConvexIneq f f')
    (hT : G.CliqueFree 3) (hf' : ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → f' x ≤ 0)
    : 𝔼 v, #V(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ) * f d(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ)
    ≥ #V(G) * f d(G) + shearerError G f f' (d(G) + 1) (d(G) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hV : Nonempty V
  · refine le_trans ?_ (convex_step_expect (F := G.closedNeighborSet) hf)
    gcongr
    rw [expect_card_closedNeighborSet hV, expect_card_edgeIncidenceFinset_closedNeighborSet_real hT,
      ← Rat.cast_pow]
    by_cases hdG : d(G) = 0
    · simp [hdG, degree_eq_zero_of_averageDegree_eq_zero]
    · exact shearerError_le_shearerError_of_le hf'
        (Rat.cast_le.2 sq_averageDegree_le_expect_sq_degree) (averageDegree_pos_of_ne_zero hdG)
  · simp_all [shearerError_of_isEmpty, card_vertexFinset_eq_zero_of_isEmpty]

name: SimpleGraph.Shearer_bound_aux
statement:
private lemma Shearer_bound_aux {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConvexIneq f f')
    (hf' : ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → f' x ≤ 0)
    (h_extra : ∀ {V' : Type} [Fintype V'] {G' : SimpleGraph V'},
      0 ≤ G'.shearerError f f' (d(G') + 1) (d(G') ^ 2) + 1)
    (n : ℕ) (ih : ∀ m, m < n → ∀ {V' : Type} [Fintype V'] {G' : SimpleGraph V'},
      m = #V(G') → G'.CliqueFree 3 → α(G') ≥ m * f d(G'))
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V} (hcard : n = #V(G)) (hT : G.CliqueFree 3) :
    α(G) ≥ n * f d(G)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hV : Nonempty V
  · rw [← expect_const (univ_nonempty_iff.mpr hV) (α(G) : ℝ)]
    calc
      𝔼 v, (α(G) : ℝ)   ≥ 𝔼 v, ((α(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        expect_le_expect fun _ _ ↦
          Nat.cast_le.2 (indepNum_induce_compl_closedNeighborSet_add_one_le _)
      _                 = 𝔼 v, (α(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ) + 1 : ℝ) := by simp
      _                 = (𝔼 v, (α(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ) : ℝ)) + 1 := by
        rw [expect_add_distrib, expect_const (univ_nonempty_iff.mpr hV) _]
      _                 ≥ (𝔼 v, #V(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ) *
                          f d(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ)) + 1 := by
        gcongr
        apply ih
        · rw [hcard]
          exact card_vertexFinset_induce_compl_lt closedNeighborSet_nonempty
        · rfl
        · exact CliqueFree.comap ⟨Copy.induce G _⟩ hT
      _                 ≥ #V(G) * f d(G) + shearerError G f f' (d(G) + 1) (d(G) ^ 2) + 1 := by
        gcongr
        exact convex_step_expect_closedNeighbor hf hT hf'
      _                 ≥ #V(G) * f d(G) + 0  := by
        rw [add_assoc]
        gcongr
        exact h_extra
      _                 = #V(G) * f d(G)      := add_zero _
    rw [hcard]
  · rw [card_vertexFinset_eq_zero_of_isEmpty (not_nonempty_iff.mp hV)] at hcard
    simp [hcard]

name: SimpleGraph.Shearer_bound
statement:
theorem Shearer_bound (hT : G.CliqueFree 3) {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConvexIneq f f')
    (hf' : ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → f' x ≤ 0)
    (h_extra : ∀ {V' : Type} [Fintype V'] {G' : SimpleGraph V'},
      0 ≤ G'.shearerError f f' (d(G') + 1) (d(G') ^ 2) + 1)
    : α(G) ≥ #V(G) * f d(G)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ n, ∀ {V' : Type} [Fintype V'] {G' : SimpleGraph V'} (hn : n = #V(G'))
    (hT : G'.CliqueFree 3), α(G') ≥ n * (f d(G')) from (h _ rfl hT)
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | _ n hn =>
  intro V _ G hcard hT
  exact Shearer_bound_aux hf hf' h_extra n hn hcard hT

name: SimpleGraph.independent_set_count_bound_step
statement:
private lemma independent_set_count_bound_step {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hn : ∀ m, m < n → ∀ {V' : Type} [Fintype V'] {G' : SimpleGraph V'},
      m = #V(G') → G'.CliqueFree 3 → #ℐ(G') ≥ Real.exp (#V(G') * f d(G')))
    (hcard : n = #V(G)) (hT : G.CliqueFree 3) (hf : ConvexIneq f f')
    (hf' : ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → f' x ≤ 0)
    (h_extra : ∀ {V' : Type} [Fintype V'] {G' : SimpleGraph V'},
      1 ≤ Real.exp (G'.shearerError f f' 1 d(G')) +
        Real.exp (G'.shearerError f f' (d(G') + 1) (d(G') ^ 2)))
    : #ℐ(G) ≥ Real.exp (#V(G) * f d(G))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hV : Nonempty V
  · rw [← expect_const (univ_nonempty_iff.mpr hV) (#ℐ(G) : ℝ)]
    have key (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
        (#ℐ(G.induce Sᶜ) : ℝ) ≥ Real.exp (#V(G.induce Sᶜ) * f d(G.induce Sᶜ)) := by
      apply hn (#V(G.induce Sᶜ))
      · rw [hcard]
        exact card_vertexFinset_induce_compl_lt hS
      · rfl
      · exact CliqueFree.comap ⟨Copy.induce G _⟩ hT
    calc
      𝔼 v, (#ℐ(G) : ℝ)
            = 𝔼 v, (#ℐ(G.induce {v}ᶜ) + #ℐ(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ) : ℝ ) := by
        apply expect_congr rfl
        exact_mod_cast fun _ _ ↦ card_indepSetFinsetAll_recursion _
      _   =   𝔼 v, (#ℐ(G.induce {v}ᶜ) : ℝ)
            + 𝔼 v, (#ℐ(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ) : ℝ )  := expect_add_distrib _ _ _
      _   ≥   𝔼 v, Real.exp (#V(G.induce {v}ᶜ) * f d(G.induce {v}ᶜ))
            + 𝔼 v, Real.exp (#V(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ)
                              * f d(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ)) := by
        gcongr <;> apply key
        · exact Set.singleton_nonempty _
        · exact closedNeighborSet_nonempty
      _   ≥   Real.exp (𝔼 v, #V(G.induce {v}ᶜ) * f d(G.induce {v}ᶜ))
            + Real.exp (𝔼 v, #V(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ)
                              * f d(G.induce (G.closedNeighborSet v)ᶜ)) := by
        gcongr <;> exact Real.exp_expect_le_expect_exp (univ_nonempty_iff.2 hV) _
      _   ≥   Real.exp (#V(G) * f d(G) + shearerError G f f' 1 d(G))
            + Real.exp (#V(G) * f d(G) + shearerError G f f' (d(G) + 1) (d(G) ^ 2)) := by
        gcongr
        · exact convex_step_expect_vertex_complement hf
        · exact convex_step_expect_closedNeighbor hf hT hf'
      _   = Real.exp (#V(G) * f d(G)) *
            (Real.exp (shearerError G f f' 1 d(G)) +
              Real.exp (shearerError G f f' (d(G) + 1) (d(G) ^ 2))) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, mul_add]
      _                 ≥ Real.exp (#V(G) * f d(G)) := by
        nth_rewrite 2 [← mul_one (a := Real.exp (↑(#V(G)) * f ↑d(G)))]
        gcongr
        exact h_extra
  · simp [card_vertexFinset_eq_zero_of_isEmpty (not_nonempty_iff.mp hV), indepSetFinsetAll_nonempty]

name: SimpleGraph.independent_set_count_bound
statement:
theorem independent_set_count_bound (hT : G.CliqueFree 3) {f f' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ConvexIneq f f')
    (hf' : ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → f' x ≤ 0)
    (h_extra : ∀ {V' : Type} [Fintype V'] {G' : SimpleGraph V'},
      1 ≤
        Real.exp (G'.shearerError f f' 1 d(G')) +
        Real.exp (G'.shearerError f f' (d(G') + 1) (d(G') ^ 2)))
    : #ℐ(G) ≥ Real.exp (#V(G) * f d(G))
proof:

    (hT : G'.CliqueFree 3), #ℐ(G') ≥ Real.exp (#V(G') * f d(G')) from (h _ rfl hT)

name: HasDerivAt.extend_to_singularity
statement:
theorem HasDerivAt.extend_to_singularity (hU_open : IsOpen U) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (g_diff : ∀ y ≠ x, y ∈ U → HasDerivAt g (g' y) y)
    (hg : ContinuousAt g x) (hg' : ContinuousAt g' x) :
    HasDerivAt g (g' x) x
proof:
:= by
  have hInterval : ∃ a b, x ∈ Ioo a b ∧ Icc a b ⊆ U := by
    have ⟨δ, hδ, hy⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.1 (eventually_closedBall_subset (IsOpen.mem_nhds hU_open hx))
    simp_rw [Real.ball_eq_Ioo, Real.closedBall_eq_Icc] at hy
    refine ⟨_, _, ⟨mem_Ioo.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hy (δ/2) (mem_Ioo.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩)⟩⟩ <;> linarith
  have ⟨a,b, hxI ,hIU⟩ := hInterval
  have h_diff_right : ∀ {y}, y ∈ Ioo x b → HasDerivAt g (g' y) y :=
    fun hyI ↦ (g_diff _ ((ne_of_lt hyI.1).symm)
      (hIU (mem_Icc_of_Ioo ((Ioo_subset_Ioo_left (le_of_lt hxI.1)) hyI))))
  have h_diff_left : ∀ {y}, y ∈ Ioo a x → HasDerivAt g (g' y) y :=
    fun hyI ↦ (g_diff _ (ne_of_lt hyI.2)
      (hIU (mem_Icc_of_Ioo ((Ioo_subset_Ioo_right (le_of_lt hxI.2)) hyI))))
  have h_right : HasDerivWithinAt g (g' x) (Icc x b) x := by
    rw [hasDerivWithinAt_iff_hasFDerivWithinAt]
    convert hasFDerivWithinAt_closure_of_tendsto_fderiv ?_ (convex_Ioo x b) isOpen_Ioo ?_ ?_ using 1
    · exact (closure_Ioo (ne_of_lt hxI.2)).symm
    · exact fun y hyI ↦ DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
        (HasFDerivAt.differentiableAt (h_diff_right hyI))
    · rw [closure_Ioo (ne_of_lt hxI.2)]
      intro y hy
      apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      by_cases hxy : y = x
      · rwa [hxy]
      · exact HasFDerivAt.continuousAt
          (g_diff y hxy (hIU (Icc_subset_Icc_left (le_of_lt hxI.1) hy)))
    · simp_rw [toSpanSingleton_deriv.symm]
      let cle := ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingletonCLE (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := ℝ)
      exact Tendsto.comp (cle.continuous.continuousAt)
        (Tendsto.congr' (eventuallyEq_nhdsWithin_of_eqOn
          (fun _ hyI ↦ (HasDerivAt.deriv (h_diff_right hyI)).symm))
        (Tendsto.mono_left (y := nhdsWithin x (Ioo x b)) hg' nhdsWithin_le_nhds))
  have h_left : HasDerivWithinAt g (g' x) (Icc a x) x := by
    rw [hasDerivWithinAt_iff_hasFDerivWithinAt]
    convert hasFDerivWithinAt_closure_of_tendsto_fderiv ?_ (convex_Ioo a x) isOpen_Ioo ?_ ?_ using 1
    · exact (closure_Ioo (ne_of_lt hxI.1)).symm
    · exact fun y hyI ↦ DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
        (HasFDerivAt.differentiableAt (h_diff_left hyI))
    · rw [closure_Ioo (ne_of_lt hxI.1)]
      intro y hy
      apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      by_cases hxy : y = x
      · rwa [hxy]
      · exact HasFDerivAt.continuousAt (g_diff y hxy
          (hIU (Icc_subset_Icc_right (le_of_lt hxI.2) hy)))
    · simp_rw [toSpanSingleton_deriv.symm]
      let cle := ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingletonCLE (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := ℝ)
      exact Tendsto.comp (cle.continuous.continuousAt)
        (Tendsto.congr' (eventuallyEq_nhdsWithin_of_eqOn
          (fun _ hyI ↦ (HasDerivAt.deriv (h_diff_left hyI)).symm))
        (Tendsto.mono_left (y := nhdsWithin x (Ioo a x)) hg' nhdsWithin_le_nhds))
  convert HasDerivWithinAt.hasDerivAt (HasDerivWithinAt.mono (h_left.union h_right) ?_)
    (Ioo_mem_nhds hxI.1 hxI.2)
  exact fun y hy ↦ (le_or_gt x y).elim (fun hxy => Or.inr ⟨hxy, hy.2.le⟩)
    (fun hxy => Or.inl ⟨hy.1.le, hxy.le⟩)

name: frequently_deriv_eq_zero_of_frequently_eq_zero
statement:
lemma frequently_deriv_eq_zero_of_frequently_eq_zero
    (hx : g x = 0)
    (hDer : ∀ᶠ (y : ℝ) in nhds x, HasDerivAt g (g' y) y)
    (hgZero : ∃ᶠ (y : ℝ) in nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ, g y = 0) :
    ∃ᶠ (y : ℝ) in nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ, g' y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frequently_nhdsWithin_iff, frequently_nhds_iff]
  intro U hxU hUopen
  rw [eventually_nhds_iff] at hDer
  have ⟨V, hVder, hVopen, hxV⟩ := hDer
  have ⟨ε, hε, hBall⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (hUopen.inter hVopen) _ ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
  rw [frequently_nhdsWithin_iff, frequently_nhds_iff] at hgZero
  have ⟨y, hUy, hy, hynx⟩ :=  hgZero (Metric.ball x ε) (Metric.mem_ball_self hε) Metric.isOpen_ball
  rw [Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff] at hynx
  let a := min x y; let b := max x y
  have rw_cases : a = x ∧ b = y ∨ a = y ∧ b = x := by
    rcases (lt_or_gt_of_ne hynx) with hyx | hxy
    · right; exact ⟨min_eq_right_of_lt hyx, max_eq_left_of_lt hyx⟩
    · left; exact ⟨min_eq_left_of_lt hxy, max_eq_right_of_lt hxy⟩
  have hab : a < b := min_lt_max.2 hynx.symm
  have hsub : Set.Icc a b ⊆ U ∩ V := by
    refine subset_trans ?_ hBall
    refine IsConnected.Icc_subset (Metric.isConnected_ball hε) ?_ ?_
    · rcases rw_cases with h | h <;> rw[h.1]
      · exact Metric.mem_ball_self hε
      · exact hUy
    · rcases rw_cases with h | h <;> rw[h.2]
      · exact hUy
      · exact Metric.mem_ball_self hε
  have hgab : g a = 0 ∧ g b = 0 := by
    rcases rw_cases with h | h <;> rw[h.1, h.2]
    · exact ⟨hx, hy⟩
    · exact ⟨hy, hx⟩
  have hxnot : x ∉ Set.Ioo a b := by
    intro hcontra; rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hcontra
    rcases rw_cases with h | h <;> (rw[h.1, h.2] at hcontra; linarith)
  have ⟨z,hz,hg'z⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope g g' hab ?_ ?_
  · rw [hgab.1, hgab.2, sub_self, zero_div] at hg'z
    use z, (hsub (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hz)).1, hg'z
    intro hcontra
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hcontra] at hz
    exact hxnot hz
  · exact HasDerivAt.continuousOn (fun w hw  ↦ hVder _ (hsub hw).2)
  · exact (fun w hw  ↦ hVder _ (hsub (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hw)).2)

name: ContinuousAt.lhopital_iterated
statement:
lemma ContinuousAt.lhopital_iterated (n : ℕ) (ns ds : List (ℝ → ℝ))
    (hnslen : ns.length = n + 1) (hdslen : ds.length = n + 1)
    (hnDer : ∀ k (hk : k < n), ∀ᶠ (y : ℝ) in nhds x, HasDerivAt ns[k] (ns[k + 1] y) y)
    (hdDer : ∀ k (hk : k < n), ∀ᶠ (y : ℝ) in nhds x, HasDerivAt ds[k] (ds[k + 1] y) y)
    (hnZero : ∀ k (hk : k < n), ns[k] x = 0)
    (hdZero : ∀ k (hk : k < n), ds[k] x = 0)
    (hnCont : ContinuousAt ns[n] x)
    (hdCont : ContinuousAt ds[n] x)
    (hdFinal : ds[n] x ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt
        (fun y ↦ if y = x
          then (ns[n] x) / (ds[n] x)
          else (ns[0] y) / (ds[0] y))
        x
proof:
:= by
  revert ns ds n; intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro ns ds _ _ _ _ _ _  hnC hdC hnZ
    refine ContinuousAt.congr (ContinuousAt.div₀ hnC hdC hnZ) (Eq.eventuallyEq ?_)
    ext; split <;> simp_all only [ne_eq]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro ns ds len_ns len_ds hnDer hdDer hnZero hdZero hnC hdC hnZ
    rw [←continuousWithinAt_compl_self, ContinuousWithinAt, ite_eq_left rfl]
    apply Filter.Tendsto.congr' (f₁ := fun y ↦ (ns[0] y) / (ds[0] y) )
      (eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall fun y hy ↦ (ite_eq_right hy).symm)
    have hn : 0 < n + 1 := Nat.zero_lt_succ _
    have hn_tail : ns.tail.length = n + 1 := by
      rw [List.length_tail, len_ns, add_tsub_cancel_right, Nat.add_left_cancel_iff]
    have hd_tail : ds.tail.length = n + 1 := by
      rw [List.length_tail, len_ds, add_tsub_cancel_right, Nat.add_left_cancel_iff]
    refine HasDerivAt.lhopital_zero_nhdsNE (f' := ns[1]) (g' := ds[1]) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact eventually_nhdsWithin_of_eventually_nhds (hnDer 0 hn)
    · exact eventually_nhdsWithin_of_eventually_nhds (hdDer 0 hn)
    · by_contra hcontra
      simp_rw [Filter.not_eventually, not_ne_iff] at hcontra
      have hInd : ∀ k (hk : k < n + 1), ∃ᶠ (x : ℝ) in nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ, ds[k+1] x = 0 := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => exact fun _ ↦ hcontra
        | succ _ ih =>
          exact fun _ ↦ frequently_deriv_eq_zero_of_frequently_eq_zero (hdZero _ (by linarith))
            (hdDer _ (by linarith)) (ih (by linarith))
      specialize hInd n (by linarith)
      exact hnZ (ContinuousAt.eq_of_frequently_eq hInd hdC)
    · rw [←(hnZero 0 hn)]
      refine continuousWithinAt_compl_self.2 ?_
      exact HasDerivAt.continuousAt (hnDer 0 hn).self_of_nhds
    · rw [←(hdZero 0 hn)]
      refine continuousWithinAt_compl_self.2 ?_
      exact HasDerivAt.continuousAt (hdDer 0 hn).self_of_nhds
    · specialize ih ns.tail ds.tail hn_tail hd_tail ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro k hk
        convert hnDer (k+1) (by linarith) using 3
        · refine List.getElem_tail (by linarith)
        · simp
      · intro k hk
        convert hdDer (k+1) (by linarith) using 3
        · refine List.getElem_tail (by linarith)
        · simp
      · exact fun k hk ↦ by convert hnZero (k + 1) (by linarith) using 1; simp
      · exact fun k hk ↦ by convert hdZero (k + 1) (by linarith) using 1; simp
      · convert hnC using 1; simp
      · convert hdC using 1; simp
      · convert hnZ using 1; simp
      · rw [←continuousWithinAt_compl_self, ContinuousWithinAt, ite_eq_left rfl] at ih
        convert Filter.Tendsto.congr' ?_ ih using 2
        · simp
        · refine eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall ?_
          intro y hy
          rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
          simp [ite_eq_right hy]

  · exact hType.1 ⟨hx,hx1⟩ ⟨Real.zero_lt_one, le_refl 1⟩ hx1

proof:
:=
  ⟨ fun hx ↦ mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hType.1 hx) (hm hx.1),
    fun hx ↦ Left.mul_nonneg (hType.2 hx) (hm (by linarith [mem_Ici.1 hx]))⟩

name: DerivAt_Type1_imp_Type2
statement:
lemma DerivAt_Type1_imp_Type2 {l l' : ℝ → ℝ} (hType : isType1 l')
    (hDer : ∀ {x}, 0 < x → HasDerivAt l (l' x) x)
    (h : l 1 = 0) : isType2 l
proof:
:= by
  have h_mon : MonotoneOn l (Ioi 0) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (f' := l')
    · exact fun _ hx ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt (HasDerivAt.continuousAt (hDer hx))
    · rw [interior_Ioi]
      exact fun y hy ↦ HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt (hDer hy)
    · rw [interior_Ioi]
      exact fun x hx ↦ Type1_nonneg hType hx
    · exact convex_Ioi 0
  refine ⟨?_,?_⟩ <;> (intro x hx; rw [←h])
  · exact h_mon (mem_of_mem_inter_left hx) (by norm_num) (by exact hx.2)
  · refine h_mon (by norm_num) ?_ (by exact hx)
    rw [mem_Ioi]; rw [mem_Ici] at hx; linarith

name: DerivAt_Type2_imp_Type1
statement:
lemma DerivAt_Type2_imp_Type1 {l l' : ℝ → ℝ} (hType : isType2 l')
    (hDer : ∀ {x}, 0 < x → HasDerivAt l (l' x) x)
    (h : l 1 = 0) : isType1 l
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ⟨?_, h⟩⟩
  · apply antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (f' := l')
    · exact fun _ hx ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt (HasDerivAt.continuousAt (hDer hx.1))
    · rw [interior_Ioc]
      exact fun y hy ↦ HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt (hDer hy.1)
    · rw [interior_Ioc]
      exact fun x hx ↦ (hType.1 (mem_Ioc_of_Ioo hx))
    · exact convex_Ioc 0 1
  · apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (f' := l')
    · exact fun _ hx ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
        (HasDerivAt.continuousAt (hDer (by linarith [mem_Ici.1 hx])))
    · rw [interior_Ici]
      exact fun y hy ↦ HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt (hDer (by linarith [mem_Ioi.1 hy]))
    · rw [interior_Ici]
      exact fun x hx ↦ (hType.2 (mem_Ici_of_Ioi hx))
    · exact convex_Ici 1

name: F_continuousAt_one
statement: lemma F_continuousAt_one : ContinuousAt F 1
proof:
:= by
  convert ContinuousAt.lhopital_iterated 2
    [nF₀, nF₁, nF₂] [dF₀, dF₁, dF₂] rfl rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ using 1
  · unfold F nF₂ dF₂; congr! 2; norm_num
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> (rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]; use 1, Real.zero_lt_one; intro _ hy)
    · exact hasDerivAt_nF₀ (pos_of_dist_one_lt_one hy)
    · exact hasDerivAt_nF₁ (pos_of_dist_one_lt_one hy)
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
    · exact (fun x ↦ hasDerivAt_dF₀)
    · exact (fun x ↦ hasDerivAt_dF₁)
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> norm_num [nF₀, nF₁]
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> norm_num [dF₀, dF₁]
  · exact ContinuousAt_nF₂ (by norm_num)
  · exact ContinuousAt_dF₂
  · simp [dF₂]

name: F'_continuousAt_one
statement: lemma F'_continuousAt_one : ContinuousAt F' 1
proof:
:= by
  convert ContinuousAt.lhopital_iterated 3
    [nF'₀, nF'₁, nF'₂, nF'₃] [dF'₀, dF'₁, dF'₂, dF'₃] rfl rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ using 1
  · unfold F' nF'₃ dF'₃; congr! 2; norm_num
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> (rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]; use 1, Real.zero_lt_one; intro _ hy)
    · exact hasDerivAt_nF'₀ (pos_of_dist_one_lt_one hy)
    · exact hasDerivAt_nF'₁ (pos_of_dist_one_lt_one hy)
    · exact hasDerivAt_nF'₂ (pos_of_dist_one_lt_one hy)
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
    · exact (fun x ↦ hasDerivAt_dF'₀)
    · exact (fun x ↦ hasDerivAt_dF'₁)
    · exact (fun x ↦ hasDerivAt_dF'₂)
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> norm_num [nF'₀, nF'₁, nF'₂]
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> norm_num [dF'₀, dF'₁, dF'₂]
  · exact ContinuousAt_nF'₃ (by norm_num)
  · exact ContinuousAt_dF'₃
  · simp [dF'₃]

name: F''_continuousAt_one
statement: lemma F''_continuousAt_one : ContinuousAt F'' 1
proof:
:= by
  convert ContinuousAt.lhopital_iterated 4
    [nF''₀, nF''₁, nF''₂, nF''₃, nF''₄] [dF''₀, dF''₁, dF''₂, dF''₃, dF''₄]
      rfl rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ using 1
  · unfold F'' nF''₄ dF''₄; congr! 2; norm_num
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> (rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]; use 1, Real.zero_lt_one; intro _ hy)
    · exact hasDerivAt_nF''₀ (pos_of_dist_one_lt_one hy)
    · exact hasDerivAt_nF''₁ (pos_of_dist_one_lt_one hy)
    · exact hasDerivAt_nF''₂ (pos_of_dist_one_lt_one hy)
    · exact hasDerivAt_nF''₃ (pos_of_dist_one_lt_one hy)
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
    · exact (fun x ↦ hasDerivAt_dF''₀)
    · exact (fun x ↦ hasDerivAt_dF''₁)
    · exact (fun x ↦ hasDerivAt_dF''₂)
    · exact (fun x ↦ hasDerivAt_dF''₃)
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> norm_num [nF''₀, nF''₁, nF''₂, nF''₃]
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> norm_num [dF''₀, dF''₁, dF''₂, dF''₃]
  · exact ContinuousAt_nF''₄ (by norm_num)
  · exact ContinuousAt_dF''₄
  · norm_num [dF''₄]

name: hasDerivAt_F_on_S
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_F_on_S (hx : x ∈ S) : HasDerivAt F (F' x) x
proof:
:= by
  refine HasDerivAt.congr_on_open S_open hx ?_ F_on_S.symm
  convert HasDerivAt.div (hasDerivAt_nF₀ hx.1) hasDerivAt_dF₀ (dF₀_ne_zero_on_S hx) using 1
  rw [F'_on_S hx]
  field_simp [dF₀_ne_zero_on_S hx, dF'₀_ne_zero_on_S hx]
  unfold dF₀ nF₀ dF'₀ nF'₀ nF₁ dF₁
  ring

name: hasDerivAt_F'_on_S
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_F'_on_S (hx : x ∈ S) : HasDerivAt F' (F'' x) x
proof:
:= by
  refine HasDerivAt.congr_on_open S_open hx ?_ F'_on_S.symm
  convert HasDerivAt.div (hasDerivAt_nF'₀ hx.1) hasDerivAt_dF'₀ (dF'₀_ne_zero_on_S hx) using 1
  rw [F''_on_S hx]
  field_simp [dF'₀_ne_zero_on_S hx, dF''₀_ne_zero_on_S hx]
  unfold dF'₀ nF'₀ dF''₀ nF''₀ nF'₁ dF'₁
  field_simp [(ne_of_lt hx.1).symm]
  ring

name: hasDerivAt_F
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_F (hx : 0 < x) : HasDerivAt F (F' x) x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxS : x ∈ S
  · exact hasDerivAt_F_on_S hxS
  · rw [pos_not_in_S_eq_one hx hxS]
    exact HasDerivAt.extend_to_singularity (isOpen_Ioi (a := 0)) (by norm_num)
      (fun y hyn1 hy ↦ hasDerivAt_F_on_S ⟨hy,hyn1⟩) (F_continuousAt_one) (F'_continuousAt_one)

name: hasDerivAt_F'
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_F' (hx : 0 < x) : HasDerivAt F' (F'' x) x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxS : x ∈ S
  · exact hasDerivAt_F'_on_S hxS
  · rw [pos_not_in_S_eq_one hx hxS]
    exact HasDerivAt.extend_to_singularity (isOpen_Ioi (a := 0)) (by norm_num)
      (fun y hyn1 hy ↦ hasDerivAt_F'_on_S ⟨hy,hyn1⟩) (F'_continuousAt_one) (F''_continuousAt_one)

name: F_Continuous
statement: lemma F_Continuous : Continuous F
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x = 1
  · rw [hx]
    exact HasDerivAt.continuousAt (hasDerivAt_F (by norm_num))
  · rw [←continuousWithinAt_iff_continuousAt (mem_nhds_iff.2 ⟨_, ⟨fun _ a ↦ a, isOpen_ne, hx⟩⟩)]
    exact ContinuousWithinAt.congr (f := fun x ↦ nF₀ x / dF₀ x) (
      ContinuousWithinAt.div (ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ContinuousAt_nF₀)
        (ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ContinuousAt_dF₀ ) (pow_ne_zero 2 (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hx)))
        (fun _ hy ↦ by simp only [F, ite_eq_right hy, nF₀, dF₀])
        (by simp only [F, ite_eq_right hx, nF₀, dF₀])

name: F_ContinuousAt
statement: lemma F_ContinuousAt (hx : 0 < x) : ContinuousAt F x
proof: := HasDerivAt.continuousAt (hasDerivAt_F hx)

name: F'_ContinuousAt
statement: lemma F'_ContinuousAt (hx : 0 < x) : ContinuousAt F' x
proof: := HasDerivAt.continuousAt (hasDerivAt_F' hx)

name: F''_nonnegative
statement: lemma F''_nonnegative (hx : 0 < x) : 0 ≤ F'' x
proof:
:= by
  · by_cases hxS : x ∈ S
    · rw [F''_on_S hxS]
      exact div_nonneg (nF''₀_nonneg hxS.1) (dF''₀_nonneg hxS.1)
    · rw [F'', pos_not_in_S_eq_one hx hxS]
      norm_num

name: F_convex
statement: lemma F_convex : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 0) F
proof:
:= by
  refine convexOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt2_nonneg (f := F) (f' := F') (f'' := F'') (convex_Ioi 0)
    (fun x hx ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt (F_ContinuousAt hx))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> (intro x hx; rw [interior_Ioi] at hx;)
  · exact HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt (hasDerivAt_F hx)
  · exact HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt (hasDerivAt_F' hx)
  · exact F''_nonnegative hx

name: F_convex_inequality
statement:
lemma F_convex_inequality {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 < y)
    : F x ≥ F y + F' y * (x - y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases (LE.le.lt_or_eq' hx) with hx | hx
  · exact ConvexOn.tangent_line_le F_convex hx hy (hasDerivAt_F hy)
  · rw [ge_iff_le, hx]
    refine ContinuousWithinAt.closure_le (s := Ioo 0 1)
      (f := fun x ↦ F y + F' y * (x - y)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [closure_Ioo (by norm_num)]
      exact unitInterval.zero_mem
    · exact Continuous.continuousWithinAt (by continuity)
    · refine ContinuousWithinAt.congr ?_ (fun _ hy ↦ F_on_S ⟨hy.1, (ne_of_gt hy.2).symm⟩) ?_
      · refine ContinuousWithinAt.div ?_ ?_ (by simp [dF₀])
        · exact ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ContinuousAt_nF₀
        · exact ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ContinuousAt_dF₀
      · simp [F,nF₀,dF₀]
    · exact fun _ hx ↦ ConvexOn.tangent_line_le F_convex hx.1 hy (hasDerivAt_F hy)

name: F'_nonpositive
statement: lemma F'_nonpositive (hx : 0 < x) : F' x ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_mon : MonotoneOn F' (Ioi 0) := by
    refine monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (f' := F'') (convex_Ioi 0) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact fun y hy ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt (F'_ContinuousAt hy)
    · rw [interior_Ioi]
      exact fun y hy ↦ HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt (hasDerivAt_F' hy)
    · rw [interior_Ioi]
      exact fun y hy ↦ F''_nonnegative hy
  rcases (le_or_gt x 1) with hx1 | hx1
  · exact le_trans (h_mon hx (by norm_num) hx1) (by norm_num [F'])
  · rw [F'_on_S ⟨by linarith,(ne_of_lt hx1).symm⟩]
    exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (nF'₀_nonpos (le_of_lt hx1)) (dF'₀_nonneg hx1)

name: F_at_most_one
statement: lemma F_at_most_one (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 1 ≥ F x
proof:
:= by
  have h_mon : AntitoneOn F (Ici 0) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (f' := F')
    · exact Continuous.continuousOn F_Continuous
    · rw [interior_Ici]
      exact fun y hy ↦ HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt (hasDerivAt_F hy)
    · rw [interior_Ici]
      exact fun y hy ↦ F'_nonpositive hy
    · exact convex_Ici 0
  rw [←(by simp[F] : F 0 = 1)]
  exact h_mon self_mem_Ici hx hx

name: F_diff_equation
statement: lemma F_diff_equation : (x - x^2) * F' x - (x + 1) * F x + 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 1
  · rw [hx, F_at_one, F'_at_one]; norm_num
  · rw [F_not_one hx, F'_not_one hx, ←mul_right_inj' (dF₀_ne_zero hx),
        ←mul_right_inj' (dF'₀_ne_zero hx), mul_zero, mul_zero]
    field_simp [(dF₀_ne_zero hx), (dF'₀_ne_zero hx)]
    unfold dF₀ dF'₀ nF₀ nF'₀
    ring

name: SimpleGraph.triangle_free_independence_bound
proof:
:= by
  refine Shearer_bound (f := F) (f' := F') hT ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact fun x y hx hy ↦ F_convex_inequality hx hy
  · exact fun x hx ↦ F'_nonpositive hx
  · intro V' _ G'
    by_cases hV : Nonempty V'
    · rw [shearerError_add_one_sq hV]
      exact le_of_eq (by convert (F_diff_equation (x := d(G'))).symm using 1)
    · rw [shearerError_of_isEmpty (not_nonempty_iff.1 hV)]
      norm_num

name: SimpleGraph.triangle_free_independence_count_bound
proof:
:= by
  refine independent_set_count_bound (f := _root_.G) (f' := G') hT ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact fun x y hx hy ↦ G_convex_inequality hx (le_of_lt hy)
  · exact fun x hx ↦ G'_nonpositive (le_of_lt hx)
  · intro V' _ G'
    by_cases hV : Nonempty V'
    · rw [shearerError_add_one_sq hV, shearerError_one hV]
      convert le_of_lt (goal_bound (Rat.cast_nonneg.2 (averageDegree_nonneg (G := G')))) using 1
      all_goals rfl
    · repeat rw [shearerError_of_isEmpty (not_nonempty_iff.1 hV)]
      norm_num

name: xexp_zero
statement: lemma xexp_zero : xexp 0 = 0
proof: := zero_mul _

name: xexp_pos
statement: lemma xexp_pos (hx : 0 < x) : 0 < xexp x
proof: := mul_pos hx (exp_pos _)

name: xexp_neg
statement: lemma xexp_neg (hx : x < 0) : xexp x < 0
proof: := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hx (exp_pos _)

name: hasDerivAt_xexp
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_xexp : HasDerivAt xexp ((1 + x) * exp x) x
proof:
:= by
  convert HasDerivAt.mul (hasDerivAt_id' x) (Real.hasDerivAt_exp x) using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | ring

name: continuous_xexp
statement: lemma continuous_xexp : Continuous xexp
proof: := Continuous.mul continuous_id' continuous_exp

name: StrictMonoOn_xexp
statement: lemma StrictMonoOn_xexp : StrictMonoOn xexp (Set.Ici (-1))
proof:
:=
  strictMonoOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_pos (convex_Ici _) (Continuous.continuousOn continuous_xexp)
    (fun _ _ ↦ HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt hasDerivAt_xexp)
    (fun _ hx ↦ mul_pos (by rw [interior_Ici] at hx; exact neg_lt_iff_pos_add'.mp hx) (exp_pos _))

name: xexp_le
statement: lemma xexp_le (hx : -1 ≤ x) : xexp (-1) ≤ xexp x
proof:
:=
  StrictMonoOn.monotoneOn StrictMonoOn_xexp Set.self_mem_Ici hx hx

name: xexp_lt
statement: lemma xexp_lt (hx : -1 < x) : xexp (-1) < xexp x
proof:
:=
  StrictMonoOn_xexp Set.self_mem_Ici (le_of_lt hx) hx

name: xexp_neg_one_neg
statement: lemma xexp_neg_one_neg : xexp (-1) < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [←xexp_zero]
  exact xexp_lt (neg_one_lt_zero)

name: log_xexp
statement: lemma log_xexp (hx : 0 < x) : log (xexp x) = x + log x
proof:
:= by
  rw [xexp, log_mul (ne_of_lt hx).symm (exp_ne_zero _) , log_exp, add_comm]

name: self_le_xexp
statement: lemma self_le_xexp : x ≤ xexp x
proof:
:= by
  rw [←sub_nonneg, xexp, ←mul_sub_one]
  rcases lt_or_ge 0 x with (hx | hx)
  · exact le_of_lt (mul_pos hx (sub_pos.2 (one_lt_exp_iff.2 hx)))
  · exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hx (sub_nonpos.2 (exp_le_one_iff.2 hx))

name: xexp_surjective
statement: lemma xexp_surjective (hx : xexp (-1) ≤ x) : ∃ y, -1 ≤ y ∧ xexp y = x
proof:
:=
  IsPreconnected.intermediate_value₂ isPreconnected_Ici (Set.self_mem_Ici)
    (le_trans self_le_xexp hx) (Continuous.continuousOn continuous_xexp)
    (continuousOn_const (c := x)) hx self_le_xexp

name: xexp_InjOn
statement: lemma xexp_InjOn : Set.InjOn xexp (Set.Ici (-1))
proof: := StrictMonoOn.injOn StrictMonoOn_xexp

name: coe_xexpOrderIso_apply
statement: lemma coe_xexpOrderIso_apply (hx : -1 ≤ x) : xexpOrderIso ⟨x, hx⟩ = xexp x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: W_rw
statement: lemma W_rw (hx : xexp (-1) ≤ x) : W x = xexpOrderIso.symm ⟨x, hx⟩
proof: := dite_eq_left hx

name: W_EqOn
statement:
lemma W_EqOn : Set.EqOn (α := Set.Ici (xexp (-1))) (fun x ↦ W x.1) (fun x ↦ xexpOrderIso.symm x)
  Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  simp [W_rw x.2]

name: neg_one_le_W
statement: lemma neg_one_le_W (hx : xexp (-1) ≤ x) : -1 ≤ W x
proof:
:= by
  rw [W_rw hx]
  exact coe_Ici

name: W_coe
statement: lemma W_coe (a : Set.Ici (xexp (-1))) : W a.1 = xexpOrderIso.symm a
proof: := dite_eq_left a.2

name: xexp_W
statement: lemma xexp_W (hx : xexp (-1) ≤ x) : xexp (W x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [W_rw hx]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (xexpOrderIso.apply_symm_apply ⟨x, hx⟩)

name: StrictMonoOn_W
statement: lemma StrictMonoOn_W : StrictMonoOn W (Set.Ici (xexp (-1)))
proof:
:= by
  intro _ hx _ hy hxy
  refine ((StrictMonoOn.congr ?_ W_EqOn.symm) (a := ⟨_, hx⟩) trivial (b := ⟨_, hy⟩) trivial hxy)
  exact strictMonoOn_univ.2 (OrderIso.strictMono (xexpOrderIso.symm))

name: StrictMonoOn_W'
statement: lemma StrictMonoOn_W' (hx : xexp (-1) ≤ x) (hxy : x < y) : W x < W y
proof:
:=
  StrictMonoOn_W hx (Set.mem_Ici.2 (by linarith)) hxy

name: W_InjOn
statement: lemma W_InjOn : Set.InjOn W (Set.Ici (xexp (-1)))
proof: := StrictMonoOn.injOn StrictMonoOn_W

name: W_xexp
statement: lemma W_xexp (hx : -1 ≤ x) : W (xexp x) = x
proof:
:=
  xexp_InjOn (neg_one_le_W (xexp_le hx)) hx (xexp_W (xexp_le hx))

name: W_xexp_neg_one
statement: lemma W_xexp_neg_one : W (xexp (-1)) = -1
proof: := W_xexp le_rfl

name: W_zero
statement: lemma W_zero : W 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  convert W_xexp (le_of_lt neg_one_lt_zero)
  exact xexp_zero.symm

name: neg_one_lt_W
statement: lemma neg_one_lt_W (hx : xexp (-1) < x) : -1 < W x
proof:
:= by
  rw [←W_xexp_neg_one]
  apply StrictMonoOn_W' le_rfl hx

name: one_add_W_pos
statement: lemma one_add_W_pos (hx : xexp (-1) < x) : 0 < 1 + W x
proof:
:=
  neg_lt_iff_pos_add'.mp (neg_one_lt_W hx)

name: W_add_one_pos
statement: lemma W_add_one_pos (hx : xexp (-1) < x) : 0 < W x + 1
proof:
:= by
  linarith [one_add_W_pos hx ]

name: W_add_one_nonzero
statement: lemma W_add_one_nonzero (hx : xexp (-1) < x) : W x + 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (ne_of_lt (W_add_one_pos hx)).symm

name: W_affine_combo_pos
statement:
lemma W_affine_combo_pos {a b : ℝ} (hx : xexp (-1) < x) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hb : a ≤ b) : 0 < a * W x + b
proof:
:= by
  convert Right.add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
    (mul_pos ha (W_add_one_pos hx)) (sub_nonneg_of_le hb) using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | ring

name: W_neg_at_neg
statement: lemma W_neg_at_neg (hx : xexp (-1) ≤ x) (hx_neg : x < 0) : W x < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [←W_zero]
  exact StrictMonoOn_W' hx hx_neg

name: W_pos_at_pos
statement: lemma W_pos_at_pos (hx_pos : 0 < x) : 0 < W x
proof:
:= by
  rw [←W_zero]
  exact StrictMonoOn_W' (le_of_lt xexp_neg_one_neg) hx_pos

name: W_nonzero_of_nonzero
statement: lemma W_nonzero_of_nonzero (hx : xexp (-1) ≤ x) (hx_nonzero : x ≠ 0) : W x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx_nonzero with (h | h)
  · exact (ne_of_gt (W_neg_at_neg hx h)).symm
  · exact (ne_of_lt (W_pos_at_pos h)).symm

name: W_eq_x_mul_exp_neg_W
statement: lemma W_eq_x_mul_exp_neg_W (hx : xexp (-1) ≤ x) : W x = x * exp (- W x)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rewrite 2 [←xexp_W hx]
  rw [xexp, mul_assoc, ←exp_add, ←sub_eq_add_neg, sub_self, exp_zero, mul_one]

name: lt_of_xexp_lt_xexp
statement:
lemma lt_of_xexp_lt_xexp (hx : -1 ≤ x) (hy : -1 ≤ y) (hxy : xexp x < xexp y) :
    x < y
proof:
:= by
  have this := StrictMonoOn_W' (xexp_le hx) hxy
  rwa [W_xexp hx, W_xexp hy] at this

name: exp_W
statement: lemma exp_W (hx : xexp (-1) ≤ x) (hx₀ : x ≠ 0) : exp (W x) = x / W x
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [←xexp_W hx]; rw [xexp]
  field_simp [W_nonzero_of_nonzero hx hx₀]

name: W_lt_log
statement: lemma W_lt_log (hx : xexp 1 < x) : W x < log x
proof:
:= by
  have hx1 := lt_of_le_of_lt self_le_xexp hx
  have hx2 := (le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (xexp_le (by linarith)) hx))
  rw [←exp_lt_exp, exp_log (by linarith), exp_W hx2 (by linarith)]
  apply div_lt_self (by linarith)
  convert StrictMonoOn_W' (xexp_le (by linarith)) hx
  rw [W_xexp (by linarith)]

name: log_sub_loglog_lt_W
statement: lemma log_sub_loglog_lt_W (hx : xexp 1 < x) : log x - log (log x) < W x
proof:
:= by
  have hx1 := lt_of_le_of_lt self_le_xexp hx
  have hx2 := (le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (xexp_le (by linarith)) hx))
  rw [←exp_lt_exp, exp_sub, exp_log (by linarith), exp_log (log_pos hx1), exp_W hx2 (by linarith)]
  refine div_lt_div_of_pos_left (by linarith) (W_pos_at_pos (by linarith)) (W_lt_log hx)

name: continuousOn_W
statement: lemma continuousOn_W : ContinuousOn W (Set.Ici (xexp (-1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
  exact xexpOrderIso.symm.continuous.subtype_val.congr (fun a ↦ (W_coe a).symm)

name: hasDerivAt_W
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_W (hx : xexp (-1) < x) : HasDerivAt W (exp (-W x) / (1 + W x)) x
proof:
:= by
  convert HasDerivAt.of_local_left_inverse
    (ContinuousOn.continuousAt continuousOn_W (Ici_mem_nhds hx)) hasDerivAt_xexp
    (mul_ne_zero_iff.2 ⟨(ne_of_lt (one_add_W_pos hx)).symm, exp_ne_zero _⟩)
    (Filter.eventually_iff_exists_mem.2 ⟨_, Ici_mem_nhds hx, fun _ hy ↦ xexp_W hy⟩) using 1
  rw [mul_inv, exp_neg, inv_mul_eq_div]

name: continuousAt_W
statement: lemma continuousAt_W (hx : xexp (-1) < x) : ContinuousAt W x
proof:

proof:
:= by

name: IntAverage_eq
statement:
lemma IntAverage_eq (a b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hCont : ContinuousOn g (Set.uIcc a b))
    : IntAverage a b g = ∫ y in 0..1, g ((b-a) * y + a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IntAverage]
  split_ifs
  · simp_all
  · rw [interval_average_eq_div]
    refine div_eq_of_eq_mul ?_ ?_
    · (expose_names; exact sub_ne_zero_of_ne h)
    · rw [←intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
      symm
      convert intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv' (a := 0) (b := 1)
        (f := fun t ↦ (b - a)*t + a) (f' := fun _ ↦ b - a) (g := g) ?_ ?_ ?_ using 1
      · simp
      · norm_num
      · intro _ _
        rw [hasDerivAt_add_const_iff]
        convert hasDerivAt_mul_const (b-a) using 1
        ext; ring
      · exact continuousOn_const
      · convert hCont
        rw [image_affine_uIcc]
        congr! <;> ring

name: IntAverage_ConvexOn
proof:
:= by
  rw [convexOn_iff_pairwise_pos] at *
  have hCon := Convex.isConnected hConvex.1 (Set.nonempty_of_mem ha)
  have hAux : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 1 := by
            simp only [zero_le_one, Set.uIcc_of_le, Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at *
  refine ⟨hConvex.1,?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy hneq a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ ha₁₂
  rw [IntAverage_eq, IntAverage_eq, IntAverage_eq]
  · rw [←intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ←intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      ←intervalIntegral.integral_add]
    · apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on_of_le_Ioo (by norm_num)
      · refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (ContinuousOn.comp' hCont ?_ ?_)
        · exact Continuous.continuousOn (affine_continuous _ _)
        · rw [Set.mapsTo_iff_image_subset, image_affine_uIcc]
          refine uIcc_sub_connected hCon ?_ ?_
          · convert ha; ring
          · convert (convex_iff_add_mem.1 hConvex.1) hx hy (le_of_lt ha₁)
              (le_of_lt ha₂) ha₁₂ using 1
            simp [smul_eq_mul]
      · apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (ContinuousOn.add ?_ ?_)
        · refine ContinuousOn.const_smul (ContinuousOn.comp' hCont ?_ ?_) a₁
          · exact Continuous.continuousOn (affine_continuous _ _)
          · rw [Set.mapsTo_iff_image_subset, image_affine_uIcc]
            refine uIcc_sub_connected hCon ?_ ?_
            · convert ha; ring
            · convert hx; ring
        · refine ContinuousOn.const_smul (ContinuousOn.comp' hCont ?_ ?_) a₂
          · exact Continuous.continuousOn (affine_continuous _ _)
          · rw [Set.mapsTo_iff_image_subset, image_affine_uIcc]
            refine uIcc_sub_connected hCon ?_ ?_
            · convert ha; ring
            · convert hy; ring
      · intro t ht
        convert hConvex.2 ?_ ?_ ?_ ha₁ ha₂ ha₁₂ using 2
        · rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq ha₁₂]; ring
        · refine uIcc_sub_connected hCon ha hx ?_
          have this := image_affine_uIcc (x-a) a 0 1
          ring_nf at this
          rw [←this]
          exact (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mpr ⟨t, ⟨hAux ht, by ring⟩⟩
        · refine uIcc_sub_connected hCon ha hy ?_
          have this := image_affine_uIcc (y-a) a 0 1
          ring_nf at this
          rw [←this]
          exact (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mpr ⟨t, ⟨hAux ht, by ring⟩⟩
        · simp_all [(ne_of_lt ht.1).symm]
    · apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      refine ContinuousOn.const_smul (ContinuousOn.comp' hCont ?_ ?_) a₁
      · exact Continuous.continuousOn (affine_continuous _ _)
      · rw [Set.mapsTo_iff_image_subset, image_affine_uIcc]
        refine uIcc_sub_connected hCon ?_ ?_
        · convert ha; ring
        · convert hx; ring
    · apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      refine ContinuousOn.const_smul (ContinuousOn.comp' hCont ?_ ?_) a₂
      · exact Continuous.continuousOn (affine_continuous _ _)
      · rw [Set.mapsTo_iff_image_subset, image_affine_uIcc]
        refine uIcc_sub_connected hCon ?_ ?_
        · convert ha; ring
        · convert hy; ring
  · exact ContinuousOn.mono hCont (uIcc_sub_connected hCon ha hy)
  · exact ContinuousOn.mono hCont (uIcc_sub_connected hCon ha hx)
  · refine ContinuousOn.mono hCont (uIcc_sub_connected hCon ha ?_)
    convert (convex_iff_add_mem.1 hConvex.1) hx hy (le_of_lt ha₁)
              (le_of_lt ha₂) ha₁₂ using 1

name: ddnG'_at_two
statement: lemma ddnG'_at_two : ddnG' 2 = P' 2
proof: := by rw [ddnG', sub_self, mul_zero, zero_add]

name: G_rw
statement: lemma G_rw (hx : x ≠ 2) : G x = nG x / (x - 2)
proof: := ite_eq_right hx

name: G_two_rw
statement: lemma G_two_rw : G 2 = P 2
proof: := ite_eq_left rfl

name: G'_rw
statement: lemma G'_rw (hx : x ≠ 2) : G' x = (P x - G x) / (x - 2)
proof:
:= by
  field_simp [(sub_ne_zero_of_ne hx)]
  rw [G', ite_eq_right hx, G_rw hx]
  field_simp [(sub_ne_zero_of_ne hx)]

statement: lemma G'_rw' (hx : x ≠ 2) : G' x = nG' x / (x - 2)^2

proof: := ite_eq_left rfl

name: G_diff_equation
statement: lemma G_diff_equation : G x + (x - 2) * G' x = P x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 2
  · rw [hx, sub_self, zero_mul, add_zero, G, ite_eq_left rfl]
    rfl
  · rw [G'_rw hx, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hx)]
    ring

name: HasDerivAt_P_prim
statement: lemma HasDerivAt_P_prim (hx : x ∈ Di) : HasDerivAt P_prim (P x) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold P_prim
  convert HasDerivAt.add (f := fun x ↦ (1 / 2) * (W x)^2) (f' := W x * W' x)
    ?_ (hasDerivAt_W₀ hx) using 1
  · unfold W'
    field_simp [W_add_one_nonzero hx]
  · convert HasDerivAt.const_mul (1/2)
      (HasDerivAt.mul (hasDerivAt_W₀ hx) (hasDerivAt_W₀ hx)) using 1
    · ext _
      simp only [one_div, Pi.mul_apply, mul_eq_mul_left_iff, inv_eq_zero,
      OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, or_false]
      ring
    · ring

name: G_int_eq_G
statement: lemma G_int_eq_G : Set.EqOn G_int G Di
proof:
:= by
  intro _ hx
  unfold G G_int IntAverage
  split_ifs
  · simp [P]
  · rw [interval_average_eq_div]
    congr 1
    convert intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (f := P_prim) (f' := P) ?_ ?_ using 1
    · rfl
    · intro _ ht
      apply HasDerivAt_P_prim
      exact lt_mem_uIcc two_mem_domain_interior hx ht
    · apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      intro _ hy
      refine ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt (continuousAt_P ?_)
      exact lt_mem_uIcc two_mem_domain_interior hx hy

name: G_convexOn

proof:
:=
  ConvexOn.congr (IntAverage_ConvexOn (ConvexOn.subset ConvexOn_P Di_sub_D (convex_Ioi _))
    (ContinuousOn.mono continuousOn_P Di_sub_D) two_mem_domain_interior) G_int_eq_G

name: nG'_hasDerivAt
statement: lemma nG'_hasDerivAt (hx : x ∈ Di) : HasDerivAt nG' (dnG' x) x
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ P t * (t - 2)) (P' x * (x - 2) + P x) x := by
    convert HasDerivAt.mul (hasDerivAt_P hx) (HasDerivAt.add_const (-2) (hasDerivAt_id' x)) using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | ring
  convert HasDerivAt.sub h₁ (nG_hasDerivAt hx) using 1
  all_goals try rfl
  unfold dnG'
  ring

statement: lemma dnG'_hasDerivAt (hx : x ∈ Di) : HasDerivAt dnG' (ddnG' x) x

:= by

proof:
:= by

  linarith

name: G_hasDerivAt_aux
statement: lemma G_hasDerivAt_aux (hx : x ∈ Di \ {2}) : HasDerivAt G (G' x) x
proof:
:= by
  refine HasDerivAt.congr_on_open (IsOpen.and (isOpen_lt' _) isOpen_ne) hx
      ?_ (fun _ hy ↦ (ite_eq_right hy.2).symm)
  convert HasDerivAt.div (nG_hasDerivAt hx.1)
    (HasDerivAt.add_const (-2) (hasDerivAt_id' x)) (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hx.2 ) using 1
  all_goals try rfl
  rw [mul_one];
  exact ite_eq_right hx.2

name: G'_continuousAt_two
statement: lemma G'_continuousAt_two : ContinuousAt G' 2
proof:
:= by
  convert ContinuousAt.lhopital_iterated 2
    [nG', dnG', ddnG'] [fun x ↦ (x-2)^2, fun x ↦ 2*(x-2), fun x ↦ 2] rfl rfl
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ using 1
  · unfold G' nG'; simp [ddnG'_at_two]
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> (rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]; use 2, (by norm_num); intro _ hy)
    · exact nG'_hasDerivAt (nonneg_mem_domain_interior (le_of_lt (pos_of_dist_two_lt_two hy)))
    · exact dnG'_hasDerivAt (nonneg_mem_domain_interior (le_of_lt (pos_of_dist_two_lt_two hy)))
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
    · intro x
      convert Polynomial.hasDerivAt (X^2 - 4*X + 4 : ℝ[X]) _ <;> norm_num
      all_goals first | rfl | ring
    · intro x
      convert Polynomial.hasDerivAt (2*X - 4 : ℝ[X]) _ <;> norm_num
      all_goals first | rfl | ring
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k
    · simp [nG, nG']
    · simp [dnG']
  · intro k _
    interval_cases k <;> simp
  · exact ddnG'_continuousAt two_mem_domain_interior
  · exact continuousAt_const
  · simp

name: G_hasDerivAt
statement: lemma G_hasDerivAt (hx : x ∈ Di) : HasDerivAt G (G' x) x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx2 : x = 2
  · rw [hx2]
    exact HasDerivAt.extend_to_singularity Di_open two_mem_domain_interior
      (fun _ hy hyD ↦ G_hasDerivAt_aux ⟨hyD, hy⟩ )
      (ContinuousWithinAt.continuousAt (G_continuousOn 2 two_mem_domain_interior)
        (IsOpen.mem_nhds Di_open two_mem_domain_interior))
      G'_continuousAt_two
  · exact G_hasDerivAt_aux ⟨hx, hx2⟩

lemma G_convex_inequality {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    : G x ≥ G y + G' y * (x - y)
proof:
:=
  ConvexOn.tangent_line_le G_convexOn (nonneg_mem_domain_interior hx)
    (nonneg_mem_domain_interior hy) (G_hasDerivAt (nonneg_mem_domain_interior hy))

name: nG'_nonpositive
statement: lemma nG'_nonpositive (hx : 0 ≤ x) : nG' x ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsub₁ : Set.Icc 0 2 ⊆ Di := (IsConnected.Icc_subset
        (isConnected_Ioi) (zero_mem_domain_interior) (two_mem_domain_interior))
  have hsub₂ : Set.Ici 2 ⊆ Di := (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr two_mem_domain_interior)
  have h₁ : MonotoneOn nG' (Set.Icc 0 2) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (f' := dnG')
    · exact nG'_continuousOn.mono hsub₁
    · rw [interior_Icc]
      exact fun y hy ↦ HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt (nG'_hasDerivAt (hsub₁ (Set.mem_Icc_of_Ioo hy)))
    · rw [interior_Icc]
      intro x hx
      apply dnG'_nonnegative (hsub₁ (Set.mem_Icc_of_Ioo hx)) (le_of_lt hx.2)
    · exact convex_Icc _ _
  have h₂ : AntitoneOn nG' (Set.Ici 2) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (f' := dnG')
    · exact nG'_continuousOn.mono hsub₂
    · rw [interior_Ici]
      refine fun y hy ↦ HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt (nG'_hasDerivAt (hsub₂ (Set.mem_Ici_of_Ioi hy)))
    · rw [interior_Ici]
      intro x hx
      exact dnG'_nonpositive (hsub₂ (Set.mem_Ici_of_Ioi hx)) (le_of_lt hx)
    · exact convex_Ici _
  have h₃ : nG' 2 = 0 := by simp [nG', nG]
  rw [←h₃]
  rcases le_total x 2 with (hx' | hx')
  · exact h₁ ⟨hx, hx'⟩ (Set.right_mem_Icc.2 (zero_le_two)) hx'
  · exact h₂ Set.self_mem_Ici hx' hx'

name: G'_nonpositive
statement: lemma G'_nonpositive (hx : 0 ≤ x) : G' x ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx' : x = 2
  · rw [hx', G'_two_rw]
    exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (P'_neg two_mem_domain_interior)) zero_le_two
  · rw [G'_rw' hx']
    exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (nG'_nonpositive hx) (sq_nonneg _)

name: goal_pos
statement: lemma goal_pos :  0 < goal x
proof:
:= by
  rw [goal]
  positivity

name: goal_rewrite
statement: lemma goal_rewrite (hx : x ∈ D) : goal x = rexp (-x * G' x - G x) * (1 + P x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [goal, mul_add, mul_one, P, ←exp_add, W_eq_self_mul_P hx]
  congr 2
  rw [←G_diff_equation]
  ring

name: bound_is_sufficient
statement: lemma bound_is_sufficient (hx : x ∈ D) (hB : 0 < bound x) : 1 < goal x
proof:
:= by
  rw [←log_lt_log_iff zero_lt_one goal_pos, log_one, goal_rewrite hx,
    log_mul (exp_ne_zero _) (by linarith [@P_pos x]), log_exp]
  refine lt_trans hB ?_
  rw [bound]
  gcongr
  exact Real.lt_log_one_add_of_pos P_pos

name: bound_two
statement: lemma bound_two : bound 2 = term₂ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [bound, term₂, G'_two_rw, G_two_rw, P', W', W_eq_self_mul_P two_mem_domain]
  have _ : P 2 + 2      ≠ 0 := (ne_of_lt (add_pos P_pos zero_lt_two)).symm
  have _ : 2 * P 2 + 1  ≠ 0 := (ne_of_lt (add_pos (by linarith [@P_pos 2]) zero_lt_one)).symm
  field_simp
  ring

name: bound_at_not_two
statement: lemma bound_at_not_two (hxD : x ∈ D) (hx : x ≠ 2) : bound x = term₁ x / (x - 2)^2
proof:
:= by
  have _ : P x + 2  ≠ 0     := (ne_of_lt (add_pos P_pos zero_lt_two)).symm
  rw [bound, term₁, G'_rw hx, G_rw hx, W_eq_self_mul_P hxD]
  field_simp [sub_ne_zero_of_ne hx]
  ring

name: term₁_hasDerivAt
statement:
lemma term₁_hasDerivAt (hxD : x ∈ Di)
    : HasDerivAt term₁ ((x - 2) * (term₂ x)) x
proof:
:= by
  have hP : P x + 2 ≠ 0 := (ne_of_lt (add_pos P_pos zero_lt_two)).symm
  have _  := W_add_one_nonzero hxD
  unfold term₁
  have h₁ : HasDerivAt (fun x ↦ 2 * nG x) (2 * P x) x := HasDerivAt.const_mul 2 (nG_hasDerivAt hxD)
  have h₂ : HasDerivAt (fun x ↦ x - 2) 1 x            := HasDerivAt.add_const _ (hasDerivAt_id' _)
  have h₃ : HasDerivAt (fun x ↦ (x - 2) * P x) (P x + (x - 2) * P' x) x := by
    convert HasDerivAt.mul h₂ (hasDerivAt_P hxD) using 1
    rw [one_mul]
  have h₄ : HasDerivAt (fun x ↦ 4 + W x) (W' x) x     := HasDerivAt.const_add 4 (hasDerivAt_W₀ hxD)
  have h₅ : HasDerivAt (fun x ↦ (x - 2) * P x * (4 + W x))
      (P x * (4 + W x) + (x - 2) * (4 + W x) * P' x + (x - 2) * P x * W' x) x := by
    convert HasDerivAt.mul h₃ h₄ using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | ring
  have h₆ : HasDerivAt (fun x ↦ P x + 2) (P' x) x := HasDerivAt.add_const _ (hasDerivAt_P hxD)
  convert HasDerivAt.sub h₁ (HasDerivAt.div h₅ h₆ hP) using 1
  rw [term₂, P', W']
  field_simp
  rw [W_eq_self_mul_P (Di_sub_D hxD)]
  ring

name: term₂_pos_aux
statement: lemma term₂_pos_aux (hx : 0 ≤ x) : (-4 + 2 * P x + W x * P x) < 0
proof:
:= by
  let f   : ℝ → ℝ := fun x ↦ (-4 + 2 * P x + W x * P x)
  let f'  : ℝ → ℝ := fun x ↦ -(P x)^2
  change f x < 0
  have hxD := (nonneg_mem_domain_interior hx)
  have h₁ {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Di) : HasDerivAt (fun x ↦ -4 + 2 * P x) (2 * P' y) y  := by
    convert HasDerivAt.add (hasDerivAt_const y (-4))
      (HasDerivAt.const_mul 2 (hasDerivAt_P hy)) using 1
    ring
  have h₂ {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Di) : HasDerivAt (fun x ↦ W x * P x) (W' y * P y + W y * P' y) y :=
    HasDerivAt.mul (hasDerivAt_W₀ hy) (hasDerivAt_P hy)
  have h₃ {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Di) : HasDerivAt f (f' y) y := by
    convert HasDerivAt.add (h₁ hy) (h₂ hy) using 1
    rw [P', W']
    have _ := W_add_one_pos hy
    field_simp
    rw [W_eq_self_mul_P (Di_sub_D hy)]
    ring
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (a := f x) (b := f 0) ?_ ?_
  · suffices AntitoneOn f (Set.Ici 0) from this (Set.self_mem_Ici) hx hx
    refine antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (f' := f') ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact convex_Ici _
    · intro y hy
      exact ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
        (HasDerivAt.continuousAt (h₃ (nonneg_mem_domain_interior hy) ))
    · rw [interior_Ici]
      exact fun _ hx ↦ HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt (h₃ (nonneg_mem_domain_interior (le_of_lt hx)))
    · intro _ _
      rw [neg_nonpos]
      positivity
  · unfold f
    rw [P, W_zero]
    norm_num

name: term₂_pos
statement: lemma term₂_pos (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 0 < term₂ x
proof:
:=
  div_pos (mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (P'_neg (nonneg_mem_domain_interior hx)) (term₂_pos_aux hx))
    (sq_pos_of_pos (add_pos P_pos zero_lt_two ))

name: term₁_pos
statement: lemma term₁_pos (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxn : x ≠ 2) : 0 < term₁ x
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : StrictAntiOn term₁ (Set.Icc 0 2) := by
    refine strictAntiOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_neg (f' := fun x ↦ (x - 2) * term₂ x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact convex_Icc 0 2
    · intro _ hy
      exact ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
        (HasDerivAt.continuousAt (term₁_hasDerivAt (nonneg_mem_domain_interior hy.1)))
    · rw [interior_Icc]
      exact fun _ hy ↦
        HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt (term₁_hasDerivAt (nonneg_mem_domain_interior (le_of_lt hy.1)))
    · rw [interior_Icc]
      intro _ hy
      exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith [hy.2]) (term₂_pos (le_of_lt hy.1))
  have h₂ : StrictMonoOn term₁ (Set.Ici 2) := by
    refine strictMonoOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_pos (f' := fun x ↦ (x - 2) * term₂ x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact convex_Ici 2
    · intro _ hy
      exact ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt (HasDerivAt.continuousAt
        (term₁_hasDerivAt (nonneg_mem_domain_interior (le_trans zero_le_two hy))))
    · rw [interior_Ici]
      exact fun _ hy ↦ HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt
        (term₁_hasDerivAt (nonneg_mem_domain_interior (le_of_lt (lt_trans zero_lt_two hy))))
    · rw [interior_Ici]
      refine fun _ hy ↦ mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hy) (term₂_pos (le_trans zero_le_two (le_of_lt hy)))
  rw [←(by simp [term₁, nG] : term₁ 2 = 0)]
  rcases ne_iff_lt_or_gt.1 hxn with (hx_lt_two | htwo_lt_x)
  · exact h₁ ⟨hx, le_of_lt hx_lt_two⟩ ⟨zero_le_two, le_rfl⟩ hx_lt_two
  · exact h₂ Set.self_mem_Ici (le_of_lt htwo_lt_x) htwo_lt_x

name: goal_bound
statement: theorem goal_bound (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 1 < goal x
proof:
:=
  bound_is_sufficient (Di_sub_D (nonneg_mem_domain_interior hx)) (bound_pos hx)
